At p41-systematic-method-block: Insert four compact items before p41: (1) State the domain and intercepts of y=1/[x(x−2)]. Answer: real x excluding 0 and 2; no intercepts. (2) Classify x⁴−4x² and x³−4x as even, odd or neither, and state their symmetries. Answers: even, y-axis symmetry; odd, origin symmetry. (3) For y=1/(x−2), state both asymptotes and its behaviour as x approaches 2 from each side. Answer: x=2, y=0; negative infinity from the left, positive infinity from the right. (4) Differentiate (x+1)eˣ and eˣ sin x. Answers: (x+2)eˣ and eˣ(sin x+cos x). Keep the review within one page.
